assets.title: Starter gym
assets.detail: A modest and much-loved one-room neighborhood MMA club, about four fighters' space. A plump navy heavy bag with coral bands hangs large in the left foreground, a low navy padded practice cage sits at right, a broad blue training mat with a coral rectangular marking runs through the middle. Four navy lockers and a warm wood bench stand along the back wall, two tall arched windows pour golden light across the mat, handwraps and a towel drape over the bench, small gloves and a water bottle rest on a rack. A small blank cloth pennant pinned to the cream wall. Welcoming working fight club, not a showroom, not a palace. Keep the entire cage and the heavy-bag silhouette readable without empty framing.
